Exploring Narrative Structure with MMORPG Quest Stories
INTELLCONT.TITLE_SECONDARY: Proceedings of the 3rd Workshop on Games and NLP
INTELLCONT.ABSTRACT: In this paper we present a corpus of quest stories taken from a popular commercial Massively Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Game (MMORPG). These stories are open-ended narrative, but anchored to formal, in-game actions and entities, providing valuable constraint as a narrative corpus. We present two preliminary experiments establishing baselines for evaluating similar patterns and content across the corpus.

SERVICE_UNIVERSITY.DESC: Served as Faculty Advisor and Head Coach. Supervised over the training and direction of the program, directly and through assistant coaches, to teach effective self-defense for beginners and competitors.
SERVICE_UNIVERSITY.ACCOMPLISH: The organization has trained many students, faculty, and staff in a rigorous hands-on self-defense program. The organization is one of the largest sports organizations in UTRGV. The team is also active in competitions and almost every student places Top 3 in each event they participate in, with numerous first place honors.
